name: Online Learning Platforms
description: Evidence-first coverage of online course platforms — pricing, curriculum, credentialing, and support read from each provider's official documentation, not independent audits or student surveys.

name: Coding Bootcamps
description: Neutral analysis of coding and tech bootcamps based on published pricing, curriculum, and standardized outcomes reporting (e.g. CIRR) — with self-reported figures clearly labeled as self-reported.

name: Professional Certifications
description: Industry and professional certifications assessed from official exam, pricing, and recognition documentation published by the certifying bodies.

name: Test Prep
description: Test-preparation platforms and courses reviewed from official pricing, published content coverage, and stated guarantees — not from our own score studies.

name: Language Learning
description: Language-learning apps and programs compared on official pricing, documented teaching methods and features, and free-tier limits — reported from each provider's own documentation, not efficacy marketing.

name: Online Degrees
description: Online degree programs analyzed from accreditor databases, the U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard, and each institution's published cost and program documentation.

name: Study Tools
description: Study and productivity tools for learners reviewed from official pricing, documented features, and stated data-handling policies.

name: Education News
description: Original analysis of primary-source education announcements — pricing changes, accreditation decisions, published outcomes data, and policy from the U.S. Department of Education and standards bodies. We read the source, not the headlines.
